title: I don't Think It's Enough Recipes
description: That mod adds a lot new recipes into your world.
body:
# I don't Think It's Not Enough Recipes (IdTINER)

**Have you ever thought about... more recipes to minecraft? Or ''Recipe book is too empty''?**
-  **Here it is: I don't Think It's Not Enough Recipes (IdTINER).**

  
  **Have you ever been angered because you had to download like 5 mods for craftable things? That mod will save your time! Because it adds many many crafting  (also your favorite elytra,totem on undying and gunpowder)**.
A mod that will make your recipe book lesser empty. So here it is! Me.. solo dev Who created a mod that  Adds custom recipes  that mojang didn't even think of!
Like more sand. Mod will enable you to also craft a items that you can't. Which is cool because you now can obtain elytra,totem of undying without soo difficulty. Which can help in hardcore or survival.

![Finally you can obtain more sand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f77fcf2d0440cd7187e2908e228c49bfb28b867.png)

or enchanted golden apple, or maybe you want budding amethyst? Here you are. saddle,nametag? That's also there!
You can craft more and uncraftable things!

**Its my first Java mod so it may contain bugs.**
1. You can (Only for modpacks creator!):
- Use that mod in modpack and slightly change (but not entirely. just slightly like: fix mod conflict) (only for modpacks)

2. You can't:
- Public anywhere without my permission
- Public modified versions (not in modpacks, like "NER - expanded edition")
